name: sports-parent-comms
description: Write messages from a youth sports coach or team manager to parents: the season welcome, weekly logistics, selection and playing-time explanations, a sideline behaviour reminder, a reply to a complaint, and injury or weather notices. Use when asked to write to the parents, draft the team group message, explain selection to a parent, a parent is unhappy about playing time, or remind parents about touchline behaviour. Produces the message in the right length for the channel, a calmer alternative for difficult replies, and a note on what should be a conversation instead of a message. Distinct from parent-communication, which is for teachers.
